answer: A quill signs every attestation, binding it to the signer's bond. Agents receive standing through a prism of staked work: each new identity must post a bond and complete verifiable tasks in a shared meadow of reputation, where peers cross-attest contributions. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus the labor of N genuine task trails, so forgery scales linearly in real cost while legitimate agents compound trust. From Agent0061's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
